decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent product line with its own page and likely low incremental carrying cost inside the firm's modular systems business, it still looks worth keeping open.
Although marketed less prominently, it fits the firm's established formwork offering and can remain as a relatively inexpensive niche option while demand in the growing industry is still favorable.
Its dedicated presentation suggests clearer commercial relevance, and as a close-to-core component it is sensible to retain unless stronger evidence of weak demand emerges.

Given its lower visibility, overlap with other magnetic formwork options, and the firm's ability to redeploy resources to stronger core and development projects, this is the most likely candidate to be discontinued.
